items.en: "I survived losing that duel on Eventide, I'll have you know."
"I won that duel on Eventide, I'll have you know."
"... I do have a Hegemony commission, you know."
"Honor is its own reward."
"But $brotherOrSister, surely you know that I bear a commission of the Church..."
"I have given service, and will continue to. Pray tell, is that not sufficient?"
Hand over $SP_supplies units of supplies
"My blessed $brotherOrSister in Faith, of course I will give!"
"No, I'm not giving you anything."
"I don't have enough supplies to give even if I wanted to."
"But $brotherOrSister, I am already tasked to bring these supplies to the Faithful." (lie)
"Alas, I cannot."
"Cut the posturing. You're using your stray believers as an excuse to attack my operation."
"I'm so... pleased to witness this miracle with you." (Cut the comm link)
"$BrotherOrSister! I pray you recognize a holy quest given unto me alone!"
"Does not the folly of saints and angels elevate the faith of a poor soul born of the fallen children of Earth?
"The Knights of Ludd are essentially committing piracy in my volume and I demand it stop."
Confirm the concordat
"Compromise? The Knights started this, and for no reason!"
"Let's begin by having the Church recall the Knights from their unprovoked incursion."
"I am the one wronged, I am the one who shall make demands."
"So what do you propose?"
"Don't waste my time with numbers. What's your demand?"
"This is about your technical labor pool, isn't it. Growing turnips isn't enough for Ludd?"
"Did not the Creator give us free will to walk which path we chose?"
"It's not my fault you can't provide your people with the life they desire."
"You cannot deny the Faithful a Path more righteous as they so choose."
"The immigration concordat no longer suits me."
"You heard me, the deal is off."
"I must have misspoke, the concordat stands."
"Your efforts, however noble, are undermining my authority. I would ask you to leave."
"You are engaging in outright piracy and spreading insurrection. I demand you cease!"
"I am of the Faith! How can the Faithful here be in danger, spiritual or otherwise?"
"I serve the Church! How can the Faithful here be in danger, spiritual or otherwise?"
"I am of the Path of Ludd. With hammer and sword, I will smash your meddling fleet of heretics."
"If you want $KOLT_target, you're going to have to pry it from my cold, dead hands."
"You want $KOLT_target? You can have it."
"I'm sure we can reach some kind of arrangement."
"Then I shall attack and destroy your fleet."
"This smug obstinacy is why no one likes you."
"Let's not be hasty. I'm sure we can reach some kind of arrangement."
"Death it is, then."
"Yes, I wash my hands of $KOLT_target."
"No, of course not. I'm not insane."
"What is the meaning of this? I am commissioned by the Sindrian Diktat!"
"How am I possibly meddling with the Sindrian Diktat?"
"My methods?"
"Perhaps you shouldn't let others' opinions color our first meeting."
"Good, that saves me from having to introduce myself."
"Wait, so this is just about fuel profits?"
"How do you propose to stop me?"
"Let's talk about this, maybe work out some kind of deal."
"Wait, what 'economic warfare'?"
"Why, what are these orders?"
"My loyalty is unquestionable! I demand an apology for the implication."
"You're going to bomb my colony to quash competition with Sindria's fuel industry?"
"If the Supreme Executor demands it, I shall submit to his will."
"If the Supreme Executor demands it, I shall submit to his will." (lie)
"The Sindrian Diktat keeps sending attack fleets. Perhaps we could work out a deal?" DEV
"The Diktat is sending attack fleets against me. Perhaps we could work out a deal?"
"The Diktat sends attack fleets against me despite my commission. This oversight must be corrected!"
Confirm the agreement
"Perhaps we can adjust the details of the agreement, just a little."
"The Chief High what?"
"Macario? What's he busy with?"
"Yes, I have an... understanding, of sorts, with the Spider of Sindria."
Confirm the agreement
"Perhaps we can adjust the details of the agreement, just a little."
"I reject that deal. I will offer my own terms..."
"It is you who doesn't understand. I have my fleet, I have the power!"
"I'm here to inform you that I will be ending the fuel accord."
"You heard me. The deal is off."
"Sorry, I must have misspoke." (back)
"'Technology Standards'? What exactly is this about?"
"A 'technological inspection' for my safety? What is this about?"
"This is absurd, you have no such authority in this volume!"
"AI is simply a tool whose result is up to the intent of its user."
"I concede that AI is a threat which must be controlled."
"AI are thinking beings who have been enslaved by exploiters and warmongers!"
"I need to talk to Daud about what happened to his inspection fleets."
"We need to talk about these 'inspection' fleets."
"So how's the Baird deal going?"
"Remember that new Eagle hull you were so proud of? Well..."
"So talk."
"I've defeated your fleets. You're powerless to stop me."
"So you want to pretend the Hegemony won?"
"I won, Daud. I get to dictate the terms."
"I'm not going to cooperate with your lies and propaganda."
"That's not enough. I want full recognition of my political independence."
"That's not enough. I want reparations. I want credits!"
"No? You can't say no. I won."
"I'll take this, if this is it."
"I'm not agreeing to any of this."
"Thanks for the warning."
"That station is my concern only. It is you who shall leave. Now."
"That may not be a good idea." (talk them out of it)
"I'm not saying you're under-prepared. Quite the opposite..."
Start the PK mission
Start the PK conversation
"I need you people to stop sabotaging my industries."
"We are not enemies. Why do you attack my people?"
"I share your Luddic faith, if not your methods. Why do you attack my people?"
"You attack my people. Though I serve the Church, have you not greater enemies?"
"You're open to some kind of deal, then."
"I don't negotiate with terrorists."
"No, I'm done with you." (cut comms)
"What is it you want? Speak plainly."
"What do you mean by 'End of the world'?"
"What would you do with a PK? Is it not unholy?"
"If you know where it is, why don't you get it yourself?"
"How do you know this? Is your information good?"
"I'm going to need time to think about this."
"No! Giving a PK to the Path is beyond reckless."
"A planetkiller for peace, then. Where do I need to go?"
"I'll find the planetkiller and return it to you."
"I'll catch this bird for you." (lie)
"Actually, I've changed my mind."
Try to open a comm link on this channel
Ignore it and close in on the asteroid
"Try the codes. Maybe we can avoid a fight."
"Tactical, what do you mean 'almost'?"
Close the link and close in on the asteroid
Send a salvor team to access the cache
Attempt to remotely hack into the Nexus to retrieve the location of the planetkiller
Use Tri-Tachyon command codes to make the task possible
Open a comm-link into the network
"Just do it. I've got an idea."
"Is there anybody out there?"
"I am $playerName. Who are you?"
"This is Artemisia Sun, CEO of the Tri-Tachyon Corporation."
"This is Omega calling. I have a command for you."
"How do you know my name?"
"I apologize for lying to you. Let's be honest with one another from now on."
"I want us to be completely honest with one another."
"Who are you?"
"Have you hacked my computer systems?"
"Can you read my mind?"
"Are you the Remnant AI Nexus?"
"Are you Omega?"
"You are Omega."
"You're probably an alpha core having fun with me."
"Where is the planetkiller?"
"We're being honest, remember?"
"That's not an answer."
"Answer me. Are you Omega?"
"I'll give it to the Luddic Path so they stop attacking my colonies."
"I will keep it for myself, to frighten off any who would attack me."
"I will keep it, as protection for my colonies. Maybe stop those AI inspectors..."
"I will give it to the Hegemony for safekeeping."
"I will use it to destroy my enemies."
"To be honest, I don't know yet."
"I'm going to sell it to someone rich. Like Rayan Arroyo."
"I'll give it to the Sindrian Diktat, to destroy their enemies."
"I'm going to drop it into a black hole so it can't hurt anyone."
"Reports by end-of-shift! Dismissed."
"I have your planetkiller."
Make arrangements to turn it over
"Isn't it useless without the codes?"
"I want you to promise you're not going to use this on people."
"Um. Never mind." (cut comm link)
"I'd like to discuss planetkiller weapons."
"You misunderstand; I've found a planetkiller weapon."
"Oh; never mind, then."
"Of course. It is every citizen's duty to submit forbidden weapons to the proper authorities."
"Don't you think such honesty deserves a reward? 500,000 credits should do."
"Of course. I await that confirmation."
"It was just an idea. Naturally I'll hand over the planetkiler for no reward."
"Pssst, do you want a planetkiller?"
"Absolutely."
"Well..."
"I'm serious this time. Planetkillers are a rare commodity. I thought of you; you're rich."
"Just trying to brighten your day."
"Deadly serious. Planetkillers are a rare commodity. I thought of you because you're rich."
"No, just a little joke."
"I'm going to need more credits."
"No, I've changed my mind."
"I've changed my mind. 300,000 is a good price."
"That's just what I'm going to do."
"I'd like to discuss planetkillers."
"I'm not buying. I'm selling."
"I'll just take the catalog and be on my way."
"How about I give you the planetkiller for no charge, and Tri-Tachyon will owe me a favor. A big favor."
Negotiate a payment of 500,000 credits
"I have something that will be of great interest to the Lion of Sindria."
"An intact planetkiller weapon."
"Uh, nothing actually. I misspoke."
Hand over the planetkiller
"Gladly, and at once, for the glory of Supreme Executor!"
"A planetkiller is worth at least 500,000 credits to your glorious Lion."
"A planetkiller is worth at least a pristine Executor-class battleship, don't you think?"
"Funny, I don't recall pledging loyalty to Andrada. The price is still 500,000 credits."
"My price stands. If you take a moment to use your brain I think you'll find it quite reasonable."
"My price stands. Oh, and make sure not a trace of your Lion's 'special' modifications remains."
"I wish to give a planetkiller into the custody of the Church."
"Er, good to know. I'll try to avoid them."
